ACTION CENTRE

Recommendation Log

Practical next steps generated from your fictional workspace activity.

12 suggestions · 6 tasks

Task 1 · Weekly email newsletter

  • Use a writing template with your brand tone saved, so you don't retype it each week.› Benefit = about 1 hour saved each week
  • Cancel the second chatbot plan; the one you use most does the same job.› Benefit = about £20 a month saved

Task 2 · Reply to customer emails

  • Let AI draft replies to common questions (opening hours, orders), and have a person check before sending.› Benefit = about 2 hours saved a week
  • Don't paste customer card or address details into the chatbot.› Benefit = keeps customer data safe

Task 3 · Instagram posts

  • Plan a week of posts in one go instead of one a day.› Benefit = about 1 hour saved a week

Task 4 · Supplier invoice summary

  • Keep the invoice summary as a weekly finance check and flag unpaid invoices three days before their due date.› Benefit = fewer missed payments
  • Use Agent mode only for structured files and keep a human approval step before sending reminders.› Benefit = safer automation

Task 5 · Product descriptions

  • Save a reusable product brief with audience, tone, ingredients and word count.› Benefit = consistent copy in less time
  • Review claims against the actual product before publishing.› Benefit = protects customer trust

Task 6 · AI workspace habits

  • Keep one weekly review of spend, adoption, output and risks rather than checking each tool separately.› Benefit = clearer decisions
  • Run a 30-day experiment before adding another paid tool.› Benefit = avoids duplicate subscriptions
